topic: What counts as declaring a folder public (D-50)
detail: Implemented under D-64: under a public root, local content is public only in a checkout the operator declared by binding a public root at the checkout's folder or inside it (a .git anywhere above the file, symlinked included, makes it a checkout); a remote GitHub does not report public still keeps it out. Content in no checkout is quarantined.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-14: see D-65. Nothing on disk declares a folder public; local folders reach public only through the applied policy's public_paths list (SP-076). Until then all local content under public roots is quarantined.
